acquisition_method.evidence: MS was set to data dependent acquisition with a Top-N method (full MS followed by ddMS2 scans).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Using LysC and trypsin, the multi-enzyme digestion filter-aided sample preparation (MED-FASP) approach was performed.

instrument.evidence: The global proteomics analysis was performed on a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to a nano–liquid chromatography (nLC).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Total protein approach was used as the protein quantification method.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: The global proteomics analysis was performed on a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to a nano–liquid chromatography (nLC).

reduction_concentration.evidence: HEK293 cell pellets (50–92 mg) were lysed in a lysis buffer containing 50 mM dithiothreitol, 2% sodium dodecyl sulfate in 100 mM Tris/HCl pH 7.8.

reduction_reagent.evidence: HEK293 cell pellets (50–92 mg) were lysed in a lysis buffer containing 50 mM dithiothreitol, 2% sodium dodecyl sulfate in 100 mM Tris/HCl pH 7.8.
